entities.summary: Sri Lanka is a sovereign nation in South Asia, Asia. Its capital is Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte (legislative), Colombo (commercial). Official languages include Sinhala, Tamil. Government: Unitary semi-presidential republic. Population: approximately 22.2 million. Area: 65,610 km². Comprehensive index for Sri Lanka covering ancient Anuradhapura/Polonnaruwa kingdoms, introduction of Buddhism (Mahinda, 3rd century BCE), Sinhalese chronicles (Mahavamsa), Tamil kingdoms (Jaffna), Portuguese/Dutch/British colonial rule, independence 1948, Sinhalese-Tamil tensions, Black July riots 1983, civil war 1983-2009 (Tamil Tigers/LTTE), Rajapaksa dynastic rule, Easter bombings 2019, economic collapse 2022, and Aragalaya protests.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Sri Lanka's complex history has shaped its regional dynamics, with the introduction of Buddhism and the Anuradhapura/Polonnaruwa kingdoms having a lasting impact on South Asian culture. The civil war and subsequent economic collapse have also had significant regional consequences.
